elaine_cs: Quick heads-up  Customer NimbleCare requested a short onboarding workshop + a follow-up triage slot. They explicitly want an APAC-friendly workshop evening (hands-on) + a US-friendly office hours. Can we sketch times? :spiral_calendar:

mikey_se: I can cover US office hours. Prefer 9am PT (works for late-morning ET).

rowan_enable: For APAC, they asked for after-hours SGT/ICT. Propose Wed 19:30 SGT (7:30pm) 40m demo + 20m Q&A. That maps to early morning Americas but should be OK since it's evening APAC.

sam_cs_manager: Draft schedule idea:
```
Wed 09:00am PT  Office hours (60m)  leads: mikey_se, isabel_prod
Thu 19:30 SGT  Hands-on workshop (60m)  leads: rowan_enable, elaine_cs
Fri 10:00am PT  30m triage drop-in  lead: elaine_cs
```
Keeps separation and a follow-up before the weekend. Thoughts on caps?

isabel_prod: Suggest cap 10 for workshop so we can do live demo on customer workspace. Also request: pre-setup instructions for S3/KV access and a small sample repo link.

rowan_enable: I'll add a 1-paragraph prep note and a short "how to verify permissions" checklist. Will post to #cs-templates.

ops-bot: Provisional events created. Poll posted (24h): https://cal.redwood.ai/poll/NIMBLE-45 (react :white_check_mark: to confirm)

mikey_se: Voted. 9am PT for the office hours works. I can demo logs parsing for common failure modes during triage.

elaine_cs: Note: customer asked to split workshop into 2 segments: onboarding demo (20m) + config deep-dive (20m) + open Q&A (20m). We'll record and attach transcript.

rowan_enable: Good call. I'll include a short slide deck (5 slides) and a sandbox link for attendees. Putting materials in repo: https://git.internal/redwood/cs-templates/nimblecare-workshop.md

sam_cs_manager: Decision rule: if poll >=75% availability, lock both events. Otherwise fallback to 1 combined session (US morning + recorded APAC-friendly replay). Also enforce sign-up cap as suggested.

elaine_cs: Can ops-bot add a question to the signup form: "Do you need hands-on access to a test workspace? (Y/N)" so we can gate capacity.

ops-bot: Signup form updated with workspace access question. Recording/transcript toggled ON for events created.

isabel_prod: Also ask customers to paste two sample prompts they'd like covered in the Q&A — makes session more actionable.

mikey_se: I'll prepare a short triage template for the Friday drop-in: priority, reproduction steps, logs to attach. Will post before EOD.

elaine_cs: Great. Final: emoji check-in. React with :white_check_mark: to lock times or :clock10: to request alternate windows. We'll close poll at 1759133600 (1h).

rowan_enable: :white_check_mark:

mikey_se: :white_check_mark:

isabel_prod: :white_check_mark:

sam_cs_manager: :clock10: (fine with workshop but prefer triage moved to Thu morning if low signups)

ops-bot: Poll closed. Results: 5/6 confirmed proposed plan. Events locked and calendar invites sent. Event IDs: ev-10123 (Wed 09:00am PT), ev-10124 (Thu 19:30 SGT), ev-10125 (Fri 10:00am PT triage).

elaine_cs: Sending NimbleCare the prep note now, including the repo link and workspace question. Thanks all! :sparkles:
